versions.content: 240 of 683  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 18: AUTOSAR_SWS_DiagnosticCommunicationManager Specification of Diagnostic Communication Manager AUTOSAR CP R19-11 Service Name Dcm_SetActiveDiagnostic Syntax Std_ReturnType Dcm_SetActiveDiagnostic ( boolean active ) Service ID [hex] 0x56 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant Parameters (in) active If false Dcm shall not call ComM_DCM_ActiveDiagnostic(). If true Dcm will call ComM_DCM_ActiveDiagnostic(). Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK: this value is always returned. Description Allows to activate and deactivate the call of ComM_DCM_ActiveDiagnostic() function. Available via Dcm.h
